ggsql as an engine

For ggsql, the use case is actually for folks who do NOT want to use either R or Python, but just the SQL on its own. You can do the SQL queries and make visualizations without having R running at all, like this:

[](figs/ggsql.png)


There is no R running at all in this situation. You can author Quarto documents that use ggsql as the kernel and do not use any R or Python kernel.
